prompts.background: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: background panorama for a 2D 16-bit dark fantasy platform game, Holy Diver HD. Create a distinct crimson organic inner sanctum inside a demonic citadel. Nearly front-on flat side-view background: monumental dark rib arches made of blackened red chitin, fine sinewy roots across distant walls, recessed circular ossuary cavities and small muted ember glows; repeating architectural rhythm, ominous depth. Deep burgundy, oxblood, soot brown and near-black, sparse dull copper highlights. Fine crisp pixel-art-like textured rendering matching polished retro HD sprites. The background must be darker and quieter than the foreground, without obvious solid platforms. Fill the whole rectangular image, aspect ratio 16:15. No player, no enemies, no UI, no text, no bright lava, no ground plane, no rocky cave boulders. This is an organic cathedral interior with breathing room for foreground gameplay.
prompts.material: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless foreground material for a polished 16-bit dark fantasy platform game. A flat front-facing repeatable square texture of dense crimson chitin plates and ossified red organic nodules, linked by narrow dark sinews and thin aged ivory ridges. This is solid walkable terrain inside a living demonic citadel. Small tightly packed irregular plates, warmly lit upper edges, deep maroon crevices, coral-red mids, restrained peach bone highlights. Rich crisp pixel-art-style texture and sharp legible clusters, no blurry painterly smear. Entire image filled edge to edge, uniform detail scale, no borders, no floor perspective, no empty space, no objects, no faces, no scene, no text. Texture must be clearly lighter than a dark burgundy background, and distinct from stone masonry or rock caves.
prompts.wall_face: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single terrain-mounted monster face for a 2D side-view dark fantasy platform game. An elongated crimson demonic gargoyle face emerging from the RIGHT edge of a vertical wall. Face strictly in right-facing profile. Narrow tall composition, approximately 3:8 width to height. Upper half: bony brow, small luminous amber eye, long angular cheek plates. Lower half: large open black mouth facing right with distinct upper and lower rows of short ivory fangs, open throat; the mouth's open cavity is near the lower third. Rust-red chitin plates and warm bone ridges, dark burgundy shadows. Left side embedded in a straight solid red organic wall, with no detached neck or body. Crisp detailed 16-bit pixel-art-like painted sprite. Fill the tall silhouette, suitable for downsampling to 48 by 128 pixels. Transparent background around the right-facing silhouette only. No text, no extra poses, no floor, no background scene, no extra head.
prompts.orb: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: two-frame sprite sheet for a small enemy in a 2D dark fantasy platform game. Transparent background. Exactly two equally sized sprites side by side, centered in separate equal square cells, with ample transparent margins and identical center, size and silhouette. Each is a floating round emerald-green armored orb, knobbly overlapping dark jade shell plates, a few short ivory thorn tips around the edge, bright yellow-green energy visible through narrow fissures. Left frame: luminous fissures curve diagonally from upper left to lower right. Right frame: slightly different internal shell highlights showing the orb's rolling motion, same exact round outline and center. A compact legible spherical monster, no limbs or wings or trailing particles, designed to downsample to 32x32 pixels per frame. Crisp polished 16-bit pixel-art sprite style, controlled palette, sharp clusters, no blur. No cast shadow, no text, no ground, no background.
